productQualityProblem: The frozen incumbent has 58 historical false positives, led by joy, and both representation-adaptation candidates increased false positives. A non-training selective-output intervention may reduce unsupported outputs without changing model weights or thresholds.
hypothesis: Keeping only Product-18 labels selected by both the frozen incumbent and the fixed domain-restoration model will reduce false positives while preserving enough recall to improve or maintain research development F1.

fixedSelector.combination: set intersection of the two selected outputs; preserve incumbent output order

successCriteria.historicalDevelopment: micro-F1 >=0.528052805280528, false positives <=53, false negatives <=90, micro precision >=0.5797101449275363, and no supported-label F1 regression worse than 0.05
successCriteria.shortSlice: micro-F1 regression no worse than 0.02 and false positives <=5
